note: The script asks for the hook text and one name super, then the client's end card. The rest is captions only.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: WHO MAKES THIS WORK POSSIBLE? Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:02.5. Top third, big, bold. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:03 for 2.5 s, lower left above the captions: Lucy Simpson / Chief Executive Officer, NIWRC.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2.5 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Chief Executive Officer, NIWRC under the name.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Your approved NIWRC end card: white logo on red.
mg.src: NIWRC logo (white) from NIWRC's onboarding brand file, in the brand kit 10 Oct 2026. Client rule: white logo on red. (endcards/index.json, 2026-10-10)
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it right after her last “Thank you.” and the 1 s hold, at 00:11. Hold it to the end. Music out.
